metadata.name: isolated_loan_v2
metadata.description: ZenLo V2 public loan: pro-rata or full-term interest, partial repayment, top-up, grace and recovery

instructions.name: accept_offer
docs: Starts the loan. Origination LTV uses the maximum contractual exposure, not just principal
plus interest, so a late fee can never make a fresh loan unhealthy by itself.

accounts.name: lender
docs: Receives the USDC vault rent the lender paid at create.

instructions.name: add_collateral
docs: Adds wSOL to an active loan. No price is needed; health refreshes at the next valid price.

instructions.name: buy_position
docs: Buyer: pays exactly `expected_price` to the seller and becomes `current_lender`, atomically.

accounts.name: seller
docs: Receives the listing rent; the price goes to `seller_usdc`.

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: Seller: closes the listing and reclaims its rent.

instructions.name: claim_priced_recovery
docs: From 24 hours after grace, the lender takes collateral worth the payoff with no bonus. The
surplus returns to the borrower; any uncovered payoff is recorded as a shortfall.

instructions.name: claim_terminal
docs: From seven days after grace, the lender may take all remaining collateral without a price.
This is the agreed default remedy and can lose the borrower's surplus.

instructions.name: close_listing
docs: Anyone: closes a void listing (settled or closed loan, stale seller, or expired); rent to the seller.

instructions.name: create_mandate
docs: Story 26.3. Borrower: one bounded top-up or repay mandate per loan and action. Approves the
mandate PDA as delegate of `source` for exactly `cumulative_cap`, fees included.

accounts.name: source
docs: The borrower's token account the allowance comes from; its mint is checked in the handler.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Collateral mint (the field keeps its V2 name). Canonical wSOL, or a mint whose enabled
`CollateralConfig` is the first remaining account; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Collateral mint (the field keeps its V2 name). Canonical wSOL, or a mint whose enabled
`CollateralConfig` is the first remaining account; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: execute_mandate
docs: Story 26.3. `Config.authorities.keeper` only; every bound is checked on-chain. For a
non-wSOL loan with a health trigger, the `CollateralConfig` is the first remaining account.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Must be `config.authorities.keeper`.

accounts.name: keeper_token
docs: Receives the fee, in the source's mint.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: checked in loan-core.

accounts.name: lender_usdc
docs: Repay only: the current lender's USDC account; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Repay only: receives the collateral vault's rent if this payment closes the loan.

accounts.name: borrower_wsol
docs: Repay only: receives the collateral if this payment closes the loan.

instructions.name: fund_request
docs: A lender funds an open request; the result is an active `OfferV2`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Once, by the upgrade authority (Story 26.2, same shape as `private_loan_v2`).

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Risk liquidation in the active term and grace: spot and EMA past the line, or spot alone
three points further (emergency).

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Receives the wSOL vault rent it paid at accept.

instructions.name: liquidate_overdue
docs: After grace, anyone may pay the payoff regardless of LTV and take collateral worth payoff
plus 5%; the surplus returns to the borrower.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Receives the wSOL vault rent it paid at accept.

instructions.name: list_position
docs: Current lender, Active or Grace: lists the position for `price` USDC atoms until `expiry`.
Listing again updates the same `["listing", offer]` account.

accounts.name: listing
docs: Re-listing by the same seller updates price and expiry in place.

instructions.name: rearm_mandate
docs: Story 26.3. Keeper or borrower: re-arms a fired health trigger once LTV <= trigger - 200 bps.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The keeper or the borrower.

instructions.name: refinance_into
docs: Story 26.1. The borrower moves an Active or Grace loan into an open offer, atomically: the
old lender receives exactly the old payoff (the new principal plus the borrower's
contribution), collateral moves vault to vault, and the new loan starts now after passing
origination against a fresh price with its own terms. The old loan ends `Refinanced`.
`max_contribution` is the most the borrower signed for, in case interest accrues meanwhile.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Signs every refinance; pays the new collateral vault's rent and receives the old one's.

accounts.name: new_lender
docs: Receives the USDC vault rent the new lender paid at create.

accounts.name: new_lender_usdc
docs: Receives any USDC in the new offer's vault beyond its principal; refinancing never pays the borrower.
The same account as `old_lender_usdc` in a same-lender rollover. Token accounts are only
written by the token program here, so the duplicate is safe.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Pays up to `amount`: accrued interest, then late fee, then principal. A payment at or above
the payoff closes the loan, takes only the payoff and returns all collateral. Open in every
phase until a settlement executes.

instructions.name: revoke_mandate
docs: Story 26.3. Borrower: closes the mandate and revokes its token delegate.

accounts.name: source
docs: mandate and the borrower still owns it; it may already be closed.

instructions.name: rotate_authorities
docs: Governance only.

instructions.name: set_collateral_config
docs: Governance only: create or update one asset's `CollateralConfig`.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Must be `config.authorities.governance`; pays rent on the first write.

accounts.name: collateral_config
docs: Created on the first write; mint and decimals are checked before every later write.

instructions.name: set_credit_config
docs: Story 26.7. Governance only: the credit pilot's SAS program, credential, schema and
enabled flag. The issuer is `Config.authorities.credential_issuer`.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Must be `config.authorities.governance`; pays rent on the first write.

errors.name: MandateInvalid

errors.name: MandateWrongSource

errors.name: CreditNotInvited

errors.name: CreditDisabled

errors.name: InvalidCreditConfig

errors.name: PositionNotSellable

errors.name: StaleListing

errors.name: ListingExpired
errors.msg: The listing has expired

errors.name: ListingPriceChanged

errors.name: InvalidListing
errors.msg: The listing does not match this loan or buyer

errors.name: ListingStillValid
errors.msg: The listing is still valid; only the seller can cancel it

errors.name: ArciumTierInvalid
errors.msg: The Arcium TierResult is forged, stale, another borrower's or below the required tier

fields.name: governance
docs: Squads vault PDA. Rotates every other key and holds the upgrade authority.

fields.name: ai_admin
docs: Registers and replaces the AI worker. Not a financial role.

fields.name: ai_worker
docs: Answers AI requests. Operational.

fields.name: liquidation_pool_admin
docs: Administers the liquidation-ticket pool's parameters.

fields.name: credential_issuer
docs: Issues credentials (later epics).

fields.name: keeper
docs: Triggers scheduled settlement checks. Operational and permissionless in effect.

types.name: CollateralConfig
docs: One collateral asset other than canonical wSOL. Seeds `["collateral", mint]`.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Copied from the mint at the first write; a mint's decimals never change.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth feed that prices this asset in USD. Every V1 oracle check still applies.

fields.name: max_ltv_bps
docs: Highest max LTV an offer or request in this asset may use.

fields.name: liquidation_ltv_bps
docs: Highest liquidation LTV an offer or request in this asset may use.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Gates new originations only. Servicing, liquidation and recovery of existing loans keep
reading the feed when an asset is disabled.

types.name: CreditConfig
docs: Governance-written pilot settings. Seeds `["credit"]`. The issuer key is not copied here: it is
`Config.authorities.credential_issuer`, so a rotation takes effect at once.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Gates credit-tier originations only; loans already open keep their tier.

fields.name: sas_program
docs: SAS program that must own the attestation account.

fields.name: credential
docs: SAS credential account (the issuer's credential).

fields.name: schema
docs: SAS schema account for the ZenLo credit tier (`tier: u8, expiry: i64`).

types.name: CreditOriginatedV2
docs: A loan originated at a credit tier. Carries no income data: only the tier and caps.

types.name: Listing
docs: One open sale of one V2 position.

fields.name: seller
docs: The `current_lender` when listed; the listing is void once that changes.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC atoms the buyer pays the seller.

fields.name: expiry
docs: Unix seconds; buyable while `now < expiry`.

fields.name: cancelled
docs: True when the seller cancelled; false when anyone closed a void listing.

fields.name: action
docs: 0 top-up (collateral into the vault), 1 repay (USDC to the current lender).

fields.name: source
docs: The borrower's token account this mandate is the delegate of.

fields.name: trigger
docs: 0 health, 1 time.

fields.name: cumulative_cap
docs: Everything drawn from the allowance: amounts plus fees.

fields.name: armed
docs: False after firing; a health trigger re-arms once LTV <= trigger - 200 bps.

types.name: OfferV2
docs: One V2 loan, from open offer to terminal settlement. Seeds use the immutable `origin_lender`,
so the PDA keeps signing if the position is ever sold; repayments and claims go to
`current_lender`.

fields.name: borrower
docs: Default until accepted.

fields.name: restricted_borrower
docs: Default means anyone may accept; otherwise only this wallet (renewal offers).

fields.name: collateral_required
docs: Collateral required at accept.

fields.name: collateral_locked
docs: wSOL currently held for this loan (grows with top-ups).

fields.name: shortfall
docs: Payoff the collateral did not cover, recorded at priced recovery.

types.name: RefinancedV2
docs: Story 26.1. `payoff_old == new_principal + contribution`, all paid to the old lender.

types.name: RequestV2
docs: A borrower's public ask with collateral locked. Funding turns it into an active `OfferV2`.

types.name: TermsArgs
docs: Arguments shared by create_offer and create_request.

fields.name: early_repayment
docs: 0 full-term, 1 pro-rata.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Zero until accepted.
